label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Airtable and the wallet is never read.

label: Access token secret
help: Wallet reference holding an Airtable personal access token, or JSON with token. Never the token itself.

label: Base ID
help: The app… ID from the base URL. Each node works on this one base only.

label: Table
help: Default table name or tbl… ID. A request may name another table of the same base.

label: View
help: Optional default view name or viw… ID for list_records: its filters and sort apply.

label: Default operation
help: Used when a request gives no operation. Write operations need Allow writes.

label: Operations a request may choose
help: JSON array among ["list_records", "get_record", "create_records", "update_records", "upsert_records", "delete_records"]. The default operation is always allowed.

label: Records per list (max)
help: Upper bound for one list_records; a request max_records can only lower it.

label: Allow writes
help: Off by default. Required for create_records, update_records, upsert_records and delete_records.

label: Typecast values
help: Let Airtable convert text to the field type and create missing select options. Off keeps values strict.

label: Upsert merge fields
help: JSON array of 1-3 field names that identify a record for upsert_records, for example ["Email"]. A request may give its own.

label: Records per write (max)
help: Larger requests are refused before any request. Records are sent in batches of 10.

label: Allow delete_records
help: Separate switch for deleting records by ID. Treat a deletion as final.

label: Records per page
help: pageSize sent to Airtable, at most 100. A request may lower it.

label: Pages per list (max)
help: Pages per list_records; when reached, the result gives offset to continue.

label: Fields by ID
help: Return fields keyed by fld… IDs instead of names, so renaming a field does not break a workflow.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one request, pages, batches, pacing and retries included.

label: Requests per second (max)
help: Pacing per base for this process. Airtable allows 5 requests per second per base.

label: Retries
help: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting. Without Retry-After, Airtable asks for 30 s.

label: Request size limit (bytes)
help: Bound for the incoming request and for each JSON body sent to Airtable.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger Airtable responses are refused as protocol errors.

label: Airtable API origin
help: Keep https://api.airtable.com. Another origin receives the token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
